## TODO before enabling
1. Add credential to **Telegram Trigger** + **Telegram Ack** (`telegram_bot_main`)
2. Add credential to **Gmail Send Absence Note** (`gmail_rb4family_oauth`)
3. Command format: `/absence <kid> <date> <reason>`
4. Replace `REPLACE_SCHOOL_EMAIL@example.com` in parser fallback
5. Activate after sending one test to your own email first
